argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$targetId='C7A7207052C7F10350379336B9D05473'
$targets=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:17410/json/list' -TimeoutSec 5
$t=$targets | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $targetId } | Select-Object -First 1
if(-not $t){ throw 'target missing' }
$ws=[System.Net.WebSockets.ClientWebSocket]::new()
$uri=[System.Uri]$t.webSocketDebuggerUrl
$cts=[System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource]::new([TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(8))
$ws.ConnectAsync($uri,$cts.Token).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
$msg='{"id":1,"method":"Accessibility.getFullAXTree","params":{}}'
$bytes=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($msg)
$seg=[System.ArraySegment[byte]]::new($bytes)
$ws.SendAsync($seg,[System.Net.WebSockets.WebSocketMessageType]::Text,$true,$cts.Token).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
$buf=New-Object byte[] 65536
$ms=[System.IO.MemoryStream]::new()
do {
  $recvSeg=[System.ArraySegment[byte]]::new($buf)
  $res=$ws.ReceiveAsync($recvSeg,$cts.Token).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
  if($res.Count -gt 0){ $ms.Write($buf,0,$res.Count) }
} while(-not $res.EndOfMessage)
$txt=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($ms.ToArray())
$obj=$txt | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100
$names=@($obj.result.nodes | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.name.value } | Where-Object { $_ })
$interesting=@($names | Where-Object { $_ -match 'EXECUTE|R39|R38|R43|Высок|High|Средн|Medium|Останов|Stop|Отправ|Send|готов|completed|success|CI|artifact|maximum|context|начните новый чат|продолж' } | Select-Object -Unique)
$tail=@($names | Select-Object -Last 80)
[pscustomobject]@{title=$t.title;url=$t.url;nameCount=$names.Count;interesting=$interesting;tail=$tail}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress

note: Read-only CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree for exact Creator chat target; no JS/provider mutation
